evals.prompt: Animate this shot: the robot hears a noise, freezes, then hides behind a barrel. 3 seconds, 2D, 24 fps.
evals.expected_output: Key poses with frame numbers, timing chart summing to 72 frames, anticipation, follow-through, start and end poses as frame text.
expectations: Key poses are numbered with frame numbers
The timing adds up to 72 frames at 24 fps
Anticipation is placed before the hide move
A start pose and an end pose are written as standalone frame descriptions

evals.prompt: Make my character's dialogue scene feel more alive; right now she just stands and talks.
evals.expected_output: Adds visible thought process (eyes lead), a contrasting pose change per idea, listening reactions, lip-sync accents.
expectations: The response shows a perceive-think-decide-act sequence with eyes leading
Pose changes are tied to beats or ideas in the dialogue
Lip-sync accents on stressed syllables are marked

evals.prompt: We want heavy squash and stretch on our realistic 3D human characters.
evals.expected_output: Explains the style conflict and identity risk in AI generation, proposes timing/posing and limited deformation.
expectations: The response notes the conflict with a realistic style
Identity or volume risk in AI generation is mentioned
An alternative relying on timing and posing is proposed
